purpose: Freeze the verified upstream facts, adapter demonstrations, and proposed integration semantics before external collaboration.
verified_upstream_facts: The call path computes request information before forwarding.
Caller-supplied execution_id is currently rejected by the execution-admission path with execution_correlation_unavailable.
The cMCP path contains existing authorization, gateway and audit/evidence mechanisms.
demonstrated_adapter_semantics: A valid EABC commit can gate forwarding.
No commit produces no forwarding/effect in the harness.
A mismatched request digest is rejected.
A mismatched tool identity is rejected.
A mismatched policy hash can be rejected.
A commit can be correlated to an existing cMCP call identifier and terminal evidence hash.
proposed_relation: EABC commit_id -> cMCP call_id -> request_payload_hash -> AuditEntry.entry_hash -> GatewayClaim/TRACE
not_yet_demonstrated: Unmodified cMCP production runtime enforces the EABC commit relation.
The relation is persisted atomically with terminal audit evidence.
The relation provides exclusive mediation over every possible downstream effect path.
Physical execution is hardware-enforced by the EABC adapter.
